name: DC Hub
description: Data center intelligence platform tracking 21,000+ facilities across 170+ countries. Provides facility search, M&A deal tracking ($51B+), capacity pipeline (21+ GW), real-time energy analytics, site selection scoring, and industry news from 2,000+ sources via MCP.

skills.name: Search Data Center Facilities
skills.description: Search 21,000+ data center facilities by location, operator, market, or country.
examples: How many data centers are in Phoenix?

skills.name: Data Center Market Intelligence
skills.description: Get M&A deals, capacity pipeline, and market analytics. Tracks 700+ transactions totaling $51B+.
examples: What is the total capacity pipeline?
List the biggest data center deals of 2024

skills.name: Data Center Industry News
skills.description: Real-time news aggregation from 40+ industry sources.

skills.name: Site Suitability Analysis
skills.description: Evaluate locations for data center suitability including power, fiber, water, and natural disaster risk.
examples: Analyze Phoenix AZ for data center suitability
Compare power costs in Texas vs Virginia

skills.name: Permitting & Moratorium Intelligence
skills.description: Curated, human-verified data center permitting intelligence: moratoriums, zoning restrictions, and utility pauses per jurisdiction, stage-tagged (enacted/proposed/speculative) with source links and coordinates. GET /api/v1/permitting/intel.
examples: Which states have data center moratoriums?
Is there permitting risk in Minnesota?

skills.name: Counterfactual Market Scenarios
skills.description: Re-score 316 power markets under explicit what-if deltas (power price, time-to-power, queue wait, reserve margin, curtailment) with a transparent formula. POST /api/v1/agentic/scenario.
examples: What if gas prices rise 30% — which markets suffer most?
Re-rank markets assuming 12 extra months time-to-power in ERCOT

schemes.name: X-API-Key
schemes.description: Optional. Free tier: 100 requests/day without key.
